commits.script:
# palette v2: lifted hair so the silhouette separates from a dark terminal; darker iris so eyes don't go hair-coloured
set ol=#3e2a2c w=1.6 wi=0.9 skin=#fcdcc4 skinS=#eab89c hair=#6e4e3c hairS=#553a2d hairL=#8c6a52 top=#ea8278 topS=#cc6660 wht=#fbf8f4 whtS=#d9d5df red=#cf3540 skirt=#82343c skirtS=#622229 skirtL=#9a4650 sock=#fbf8f4 sockS=#d3d3de shoe=#8c5030 shoeS=#683a22 iris=#4a2e22 irisD=#1e100a tog=#f0c040
rename-layer name=paint to=fig
layer name=preview-bg visible=false below=fig
fill in=canvas color=#1e2127
layer name=fig

# body
layer name=fig
# back hair: ends at y~50, tapered in, so the head steps out over the arms
set bh=blob(7.6,20;9.6,9.5;22.5,5;35.4,9.5;37.4,20;37.8,36;37.6,46;36,50;29,50.6;22.5,50;16,50.6;9,50;7.4,46;7.2,36)
fill in=$bh color=$hair
stroke path=$bh width=$w color=$ol
# legs
set lleg=rect(16,70,4,19) rleg=rect(25,70,4,19)
fill in=$lleg color=$skin
fill in=$rleg color=$skin
fill in=rect(16,79,4,10) color=$sock
fill in=rect(25,79,4,10) color=$sock
fill in=rect(18.6,79,1.4,10) color=$sockS
fill in=rect(27.6,79,1.4,10) color=$sockS
stroke path=16,79;20,79 width=$wi color=$ol smooth=false cap=butt
stroke path=25,79;29,79 width=$wi color=$ol smooth=false cap=butt
stroke path=$lleg width=$w color=$ol
stroke path=$rleg width=$w color=$ol
# shoes
set lsh=blob(14.6,90;16,87.6;19.5,87.6;21.2,90;20.4,92.6;15.2,92.6) rsh=blob(23.8,90;25.5,87.6;29,87.6;30.4,90;29.8,92.6;24.6,92.6)
fill in=$lsh color=$shoe
fill in=$rsh color=$shoe
fill in=rect(14,91,17,2) color=$shoeS clip=fig
stroke path=$lsh width=$w color=$ol
stroke path=$rsh width=$w color=$ol
# skirt: flared, bevelled hem corners, 1px pleats
set sk=poly(13.4,58;31.6,58;35.4,69.6;34.4,72.6;10.6,72.6;9.6,69.6)
fill in=$sk color=$skirt
stroke path=16,60.5;13.5,72.4 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=19,60.5;17.8,72.4 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=22.5,60.5;22.5,72.4 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=26,60.5;27.2,72.4 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=29,60.5;31.5,72.4 width=1 color=$skirtS cap=butt
stroke path=$sk width=$w color=$ol

# top, arms, collar
layer name=fig
fill in=rect(19.8,37,5.4,7) color=$skinS
# torso: narrow, so the head overhangs it
set tor=blob(14.4,46;17,43.2;22.5,42.8;28,43.2;30.6,46;31.4,61;22.5,61.6;13.6,61)
fill in=$tor color=$top
stroke path=$tor width=$w color=$ol
# arms: outlined tubes hanging close to the body
set la=15,45.2;13.6,51;13.3,60.6 ra=30,45.2;31.4,51;31.7,60.6
stroke path=$la width=6.2 color=$ol
stroke path=$ra width=6.2 color=$ol
stroke path=$la width=3.2 color=$top
stroke path=$ra width=3.2 color=$top
stroke path=13.8,47.5;12.2,53;11.9,60 width=1.1 color=$topS cap=butt
stroke path=31.2,47.5;32.8,53;33.1,60 width=1.1 color=$topS cap=butt
# cuffs: pure white with one red line
set lc=rect(10.7,60,5.2,3.4) rc=rect(29.1,60,5.2,3.4)
fill in=$lc color=$wht
fill in=$rc color=$wht
fill in=rect(10.7,61.5,5.2,0.9) color=$red
fill in=rect(29.1,61.5,5.2,0.9) color=$red
stroke path=$lc width=1.3 color=$ol
stroke path=$rc width=1.3 color=$ol
# hands
fill in=circle(13.3,65.6,2.1) color=$skinS
fill in=circle(31.7,65.6,2.1) color=$skinS
stroke path=circle(13.3,65.6,2.1) width=$w color=$ol
stroke path=circle(31.7,65.6,2.1) width=$w color=$ol
# collar
set col=poly(13.2,45.2;17.4,43;22.5,49.6;27.6,43;31.8,45.2;22.5,54.6)
fill in=$col color=$wht
stroke path=14.4,46;22.5,52.4;30.6,46 width=0.8 color=$red smooth=false
stroke path=$col width=$wi color=$ol
# cord + toggle
stroke path=22.1,54.6;21.7,60.4 width=0.7 color=$red
stroke path=22.9,54.6;23.3,60.4 width=0.7 color=$red
fill in=rect(21.5,54,2,2) color=$tog

# head
layer name=fig
# inner hair behind the neck
fill in=rect(12,35,21,8) color=$hairS
fill in=rect(19.8,37,5.4,6.4) color=$skinS
stroke path=19.8,37;19.8,43.2 width=$wi color=$ol cap=butt
stroke path=25.2,37;25.2,43.2 width=$wi color=$ol cap=butt
# face
set face=blob(11,21;11.8,31;16.2,37.6;22.5,40;28.8,37.6;33.2,31;34,21;22.5,12)
fill in=$face color=$skin
stroke path=$face width=$w color=$ol
# bangs: ragged edge, one strand down between the eyes
set bangedge=10,18.6;11.6,22.6;13.4,19.6;15.2,21.8;16.8,19.2;18.6,21.6;20.6,19.4;22.4,23.6;23.8,19.2;25.8,21.6;27.6,19.2;29.6,21.8;31.2,19.6;33.4,22.6;35,18.6
fill in=poly(9.2,12;22.5,7.6;35.8,12;35,18.6;33.4,22.6;31.2,19.6;29.6,21.8;27.6,19.2;25.8,21.6;23.8,19.2;22.4,23.6;20.6,19.4;18.6,21.6;16.8,19.2;15.2,21.8;13.4,19.6;11.6,22.6;10,18.6) color=$hair
stroke path=$bangedge smooth=false width=1.1 color=$ol
# crown shine: one hard lighter band
stroke path=arc(22.5,22,13.2,215,325) width=1.6 color=$hairL cap=butt
# side curtains
set lcur=poly(8.6,16;12.2,18.4;12.2,30;13,39.6;9.8,41.4;7.8,30)
set rcur=poly(36.4,16;32.8,18.4;32.8,30;32,39.6;35.2,41.4;37.2,30)
fill in=$lcur color=$hair
fill in=$rcur color=$hair
stroke path=12.2,19;12.2,30;13,39.6;11.6,41 width=1.1 color=$ol
stroke path=32.8,19;32.8,30;32,39.6;33.4,41 width=1.1 color=$ol
# eyes: big white ovals, dark iris low-inner, catchlight, top lid only
fill in=ellipse(16.5,26.5,3.5,4.5) color=$wht
fill in=ellipse(28.5,26.5,3.5,4.5) color=$wht
fill in=ellipse(17.4,27.6,2.4,3.1) color=$iris
fill in=ellipse(27.6,27.6,2.4,3.1) color=$iris
fill in=ellipse(17.6,28.2,1.1,1.5) color=$irisD
fill in=ellipse(27.4,28.2,1.1,1.5) color=$irisD
fill in=rect(16,25,1,1) color=#ffffff
fill in=rect(27,25,1,1) color=#ffffff
stroke path=12.6,24.2;14.2,22.2;16.5,21.6;18.8,22.2;20.4,23.6 width=1.2 color=$ol
stroke path=24.6,23.6;26.2,22.2;28.5,21.6;30.8,22.2;32.4,24.2 width=1.2 color=$ol
# mouth
stroke path=21.4,35.2;22.5,35.8;23.6,35.2 width=0.75 color=$ol
